offering_description.value: Operates pawn stores that make collateralized pawn loans to consumers and sell pre-owned and recovered merchandise such as jewelry, electronics, tools and general goods. Customers are mainly individual consumers, served through company-owned stores in the US and Latin America.

primary_products.value: pre-owned consumer goods; used jewelry; used electronics; scrap gold and jewelry

primary_services.value: pawn loans; consumer lending secured by personal property

customer_segment.value: B2C: cash-constrained individual consumers borrowing against collateral and bargain shoppers buying used goods

revenue_model.value: interest or premiums: pawn service charges and fees on collateralized loans; product sales: merchandise sales of forfeited collateral and purchased used goods, plus scrap sales

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: lends cash against personal property collateral to consumers; retailer: sells forfeited and purchased used merchandise to consumers in own stores

geography_served.value: global: United States, Mexico, Guatemala, El Salvador, Honduras and other Latin American countries

specialization.value: related lines: pawn lending and used merchandise retail sharing the same stores and customers

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-operated pawn stores in the US and Latin America; online: online sales of merchandise and loan payment channels

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: pawn lending licensing and rate caps by state and foreign regulators, secondhand goods and consumer lending rules like CFPB oversight
